d: Jumeirah Group, a member of Dubai Holding, has been making a distinguished impact on the global hospitality market for more than two decades with its Stay Different™ brand promise.

Its award-winning destinations, such as the iconic Burj Al Arab Jumeirah, position service beyond expectations, elevated dining destinations and surprising architecture and design at the heart of every guest experience.
Today, Jumeirah operates a world-class portfolio of 23 properties across the Middle East, Europe and Asia and employs over 8,000 colleagues, representing over 106 nationalities.

As Jumeirah continues to expand its global portfolio and scales up its operations to the next level of growth, it remains fully committed to developing and empowering our colleagues to excel in world class environments.
Jumeirah is committed to embedding equality, diversity, and inclusion in all its practices, embracing a culture that celebrates diversity.

Jumeirah Gulf of Bahrain is an idyllic getaway situated majestically on the shores of the Gulf and takes its architectural inspiration from the gentle movements of the sea. The resort’s cluster of villas and elegantly designed rooms, along with the award-winning Talise Spa, offers a sanctuary for travelers looking to recharge and embark on a journey for wellbeing. Bahrain presents itself as a destination for the ultimate Middle Eastern experience, with its rich heritage of beautiful forts and charming bazaars blending perfectly with an inspirational vision for the future. The resort harmonises Jumeirah’s promise of unparalleled hospitality with the wonder of the destination, providing a true beachside escape in the heart of culture. Set to exceed all guest expectations, the resort and spa is an oasis for nature-loving friends, families and couples hoping to disconnect from the chaos of everyday life.
q: The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
A minimum of 1 year experience in similar role.
A minimum of 2 years’ experience working in 5-star international luxury environment
Presentable and with great communication skills
r: An opportunity has arisen for a dynamic Guest Relations Executive - Food & Beverage role to join Jumeirah Gulf of Bahrain.
The Main Duties And Responsibilities Of This Role
Pick up the daily menus and insert them properly in their covers.
Inspect every menu and list to ensure their immaculate condition and appearance.
Developing a complete working knowledge of the menus, menu ingredients and what is unavailable for the day.
Assign seating taking into account service standards.
Knowing the server stations, their daily assignments, their personal timing patterns and their maximum workload capacity.
Maintaining a station chart and cover count for the restaurant.
Ensuring each guest receives the highest quality of service.
Greeting each guest promptly, courteously, graciously with eye contact, a smile and good posture.
Handling guests without reservations or those waiting for others to join them.
To seat reservations promptly at a table pre-set for the number in the party.

q: GCC Region · Full time, on site · Start: January 2027

We are building an AI education programme for K–12 schools across the GCC. It brings together a technology platform, a teacher training centre and a student studio, and it begins with a multi-school pilot in September 2027.

You will own all the hands-on technology behind it. That covers our team's IT, the hardware in our centres and classrooms, the infrastructure around our platform, and making sure every pilot school is technically ready on day one. The product is AI, so we need someone who uses AI fluently in their own work as well as running solid infrastructure.

Proven AI fluency. You use generative AI tools every day, you understand how LLMs and AI platforms are hosted and accessed (cloud, APIs, model providers) and where they fail, and you understand the privacy and safety issues of AI with children.
Strong grounding in end-user IT, networks, cloud services, identity and access, device management and security fundamentals.
A track record of buying and deploying hardware at scale, with vendors, quotes and delivery managed to deadline.
Experience with schools or education technology, for example as a school IT manager, EdTech or digital learning lead, or in implementation at an edtech or IT company serving schools.
The ability to explain technical and AI concepts simply to non-technical colleagues and teachers.
Based in the GCC, with professional English.
Experience with schools in the GCC, public or private
Microsoft or Google education platform administration
Hands-on AI building: automations, prompt-based workflows or small AI tools
r: Team IT: laptops, phones, email and office software, accounts and access, office and training centre networks, IT security policies and help desk.
Hardware and vendors: specify, quote, buy, receive and install equipment for the training centre, the student studio and pilot classrooms. You manage vendors, warranties and asset records.
Platform infrastructure: work with our platform build partner on hosting environments, user access, integrations and rollout into schools.

AI tools and practice: select, set up and govern the AI tools our team and schools use. You set safe use rules for minors with our safeguarding lead, and you help colleagues and teachers get real value from AI as the tools change.

School onboarding: device and access provisioning, network and platform readiness, onboarding and in-school technical support for each pilot school. You hold the technical side of every school relationship.
People: lead a team of School IT Technicians as the programme scales.
x: Send your CV and a short note on an AI or school technology deployment you led to jobs@xloopdigital.com. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short practical exercise.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Jira Administrator to manage the Atlassian Jira Cloud at Canonical, including the administration, configuration, automation, and integration responsibilities. We expect the highest engineering quality, rigorous documentation practices, and effective stakeholder management abilities. Our goal is to enable Canonical engineering and business teams to leverage the power of Atlassian Jira, work on challenging assignments, and enable teams to make data-driven decisions.

The role is in the Commercial Systems team that integrates business systems used at Canonical to ensure reliable data flows at the right time to the right place, and to automate business processes across the company. We own a wide range of systems including popular SaaS solutions, such as Jira, Salesforce, NetSuite, Greenhouse, GSuite, and a few dozen others. To achieve this goal, we leverage Python and Go in combination with open source tools, such as Airbyte and Temporal. Our work helps to make data-driven decisions, and increases the efficiency of business operations.
Location: This role can be held anywhere in EMEA time zones.
Manage Atlassian Jira Cloud at Canonical
Design, document, and implement processes and automation in Jira
Design, document, and implement integrations between Jira and the data warehouse
Create analytical dashboards to enable stakeholders make data-driven decisions
Work with engineering, operations, and support teams at a global scale
Take ownership of critical escalations and resolve them in a timely manner
q: Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

Understanding of common Jira usage patterns for various technical and non-technical departments

Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability

You'll collaborate with teams, manage stakeholders, and drive process improvements. Managing scrum team, ensuring effective cooperation and collaboration among team members.

Following Agile methodologies by conducting daily and weekly meetings to enhance communication and maximize productivity.

Promoting company and project standards in all deliverables.

Communicating with other TPMs to ensure adherence to project management best practices and methodologies.
